title: Slip domain mapping
description: The file a publisher serves at the root of an origin to put human paths in front of Slip endpoints. Both sides of a rule are path-absolute templates: there is nowhere in a path to write a host, so a mapping to another origin is unexpressible rather than forbidden. Normative for version 1.

rules.description: Tried in order; the first whose pathPattern matches wins, and its result is never matched again.

pathPattern.description: The human path this rule answers for.

apiPath.description: The endpoint path it resolves to, carrying the same wildcards in the same order.

pathTemplate.description: A path-absolute reference whose segments are literals, `*` for exactly one segment, or a final `**` for one or more. No scheme, no authority, no dot segments, no partial wildcard within a segment.
